title: Spider-Man 3
tagline: The black suit, Venom, and Sandman in a movie tie-in.
summary: Treyarch’s tie-in follows Spider-Man 3’s symbiote plot, Eddie Brock, and Flint Marko. The open city is less free than the 2004 game. It remains a film adaptation.
gameplay: Third-person combat with a black-suit mode, outdoor traversal, and missions patterned on the film.
